description: Searches the public discussions on Veritula by their titles and descriptions, those with the query's words in their titles first. Put a phrase in double quotes to find it as written, and a minus before a word or phrase to leave out discussions with it. Without a query, lists the discussions most recently active. Chronicles retell discussions that took place before Veritula. get_discussion gives a discussion's ideas.
name: search_discussions
title: Search discussions
